title: Run one-to-ones and give useful feedback
summary: Regular one-to-ones are where you learn what your PMs need and help them grow. Make them about the person, and give feedback that is specific and kind.

beginner: Hold a one-to-one with each PM every week or two.
In the first one, ask how they like to work and receive feedback.
Let them set most of the agenda.
Give feedback on specific situations, what they did and its impact.
Write down agreed actions and follow up.
intermediate: Give positive feedback as specifically as critical feedback.
Talk about career growth regularly, not just at reviews.
experienced: Coach your managers to run good one-to-ones.
Spot patterns across the team from one-to-ones.

toolExamples.notion: Keep a shared agenda and action list for each person.
